title: First Backpacking Trip Guide Printable, Beginner Backpacking Checklist, Gear List, Meal Planner, Camping Planner PDF, Overnight Hike Prep
description:
If you are comfortable on 5-8 mile (8-13 km) day hikes, a first overnight is the natural next step. This 32-page guide walks you through it in plain words, then gives you the pages to plan it on.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- A self-check: are you ready for a first overnight?
- How to pick an easy first route, where to find one (state parks, national forests, national parks) and permits
- A first-trip timeline: 6 weeks out, 2 weeks out and the night before
- The big three (pack, shelter, sleep system) for a first trip, and what to borrow or rent before you buy
- Sleeping warm: bag and pad ratings in plain words
- Clothing for the trail and for camp
- Water: how much to carry, finding sources and treating every source
- Simple no-cook and boil-only meals, and how much food to pack
- Storing food: bear canisters, hangs and lockers, and following the local rule
- Setting up camp, Leave No Trace for overnights, stove safety, weather and when to go home early
- Fill-in pages: 2-page gear checklist with lb / kg weights, pack weight worksheet, meal planner, shopping list, trip planner, trip plan to leave at home, night-before checklist, after-trip review and trip logs
- Official sources and a backpacking glossary

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
General outdoor information for a first easy overnight. Always follow the land manager's rules (permits, fires, food storage). For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
